title: business development & partnerships
jobDescription:
what is CRED? CRED is an exclusive community for india’s most trustworthy and creditworthy individuals, where the members are rewarded for good financial behavior. CRED was born out of a need to bring back the focus on a long lost virtue, one of trust, the idea being to create a community centered around this virtue. a community that constantly strives to become more virtuous in this regard till they finally scale their behavior to create a utopia where being trustworthy is the norm and not the exception. to build a community like this requires a community of its own; a community special in its own way, working towards making this vision come true. here’s a thought experiment: what do you get when you put a group of incredibly passionate and driven people and entrust them with the complete freedom to chase down their goals in a completely uninhibited manner? answer: you get something close to what we have at CRED; CRED just has it better. You’ll play a pivotal role in leading CRED's partner ecosystem across products, becoming the face of CRED to some of India’s top consumer brands. You will lead high-stakes partnerships, drive product adoption, and enable new growth through strategic merchant alliances. As a core part of the merchant-led growth (mlg) strategy, you’ll shape how millions engage with CRED. CRED

title: business development & partnerships – commercial lead
jobDescription:
VA Tech (a CRED company, formerly Happay) is CRED's B2B payments infrastructure business. Role Purpose: Own and scale VA Tech's commercial engine – pipeline, enterprise sales, and partnerships — across banks, fintechs, and enterprise ecosystem partners, converting VA Tech's platform capability into predictable, compounding revenue. CRED
- business development & partnerships – commercial lead business development & partnerships – commercial lead bengaluru VA Tech – business / full time / On-site apply for this job VA Tech (a CRED company, formerly Happay) is CRED's B2B payments infrastructure business. Role Purpose: Own and scale VA Tech's commercial engine – pipeline, enterprise sales, and partnerships — across banks, fintechs, and enterprise ecosystem partners, converting VA Tech's platform capability into predictable, compounding revenue. What will you do? Business Development Own pipeline generation across banks, fintechs, and enterprise ecosystem partners. Build and qualify a diversified pipeline aligned to VA Tech's priority segments. Convert market opportunity into signed, revenue-generating partnerships. Enterprise Sales Lead complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise sales cycles end-to-end. Own commercial proposals, structuring, and negotiation within an agreed mandate. Drive forecasting accuracy and pipeline governance. Strategic Partnerships Build and institutionalize partnerships across banks, fintechs, payment networks, ERP platforms, and technology partners. Structure partnership models that convert into durable, multi-year commercial relationships. Own partnership health and expansion for the full portfolio outside top-tier strategic accounts. Commercial Excellence Institutionalize commercial playbooks, pricing frameworks, and deal-desk discipline. Build repeatable processes for proposal generation, negotiation, and closure. Drive consistency in commercial terms across the partner portfolio. Go-To-Market Execute VA Tech's go-to-market strategy across defined segments and geographies. Translate platform capability into segment-specific commercial narratives. Partner with Marketing and Product to sharpen market positioning. Market Intelligence Track competitive movement, pricing, and partnership models across the payments infrastructure landscape. Convert field intelligence into structured input for Product and the Business Head. Identify early signals of opportunity or risk in the banking and payments ecosystem. Cross-Functional Leadership Influence Product, Technology, Operations, Finance, Compliance, and Legal to unblock commercial outcomes. Represent commercial priorities in cross-functional planning without owning those functions. Build working relationships that move deals through internal approval cycles quickly. Sales Governance Own pipeline reviews, forecasting cadence, and deal-stage discipline. Build a single source of truth for commercial performance. Flag risk early — no surprises in forecast-to-close conversion. Commercial Operations Own commercial reporting, contract lifecycle coordination, and deal documentation discipline. Build the operating rhythm — reviews, reporting, escalation paths — that lets the function scale. Coordinate with Finance and Legal on commercial terms and contract structuring. Team Development Build and lead a commercial pod as volume justifies headcount. Institutionalize onboarding, coaching, and performance management for the team. Build a bench for future scale — this function should not be a single point of failure. You should apply if you: Have 7-12yrs of experience in Business Development, Enterprise Sales, or Strategic Partnerships within payments, fintech, or banking infrastructure. Demonstrated ownership of a commercial pipeline — origination through closure — not just relationship management. Proven track record structuring and closing partnerships with banks, NBFCs, or payment networks. Strong command of commercial and contractual structuring — pricing, terms, negotiation. Executive presence — credible in front of CXOs at banks and large enterprises. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us. apply for this job CRED Home Page Jobs powered by
